summary: Express a made-from-sheet proposal through folds, cut edges and layered panels rather than adding paper texture alone.
objective: Panel edges and layer order remain readable; a claimed buildable pattern must be checked separately instead of inferred from this appearance.
intent_signals: Show cut edges folded panels and layers
example_prompts: Make a papercraft town with folded roof panels, visible cut edges and layered trees.

principles: Express a made-from-sheet proposal through folds, cut edges and layered panels rather than adding paper texture alone.
implementation: Build sheets with visible boundaries and small thickness where useful; place fold seams and tabs only where the proposed construction needs them.
Use matte-looking surfaces, selective printed color and soft light that reveals overlapping layers.
Offer a three-quarter view plus inspection of a fold; animated folding uses explicit pivots and states if construction is being explained.
Give every sheet 0.35-0.6 mm modelled thickness with 3-6 mm glue tabs only where the proposed construction needs them, and offset stacked layers by 1.5-3 mm so each cut edge casts a visible line.
Keep the paper white at #f4efe4 rather than pure white and set ambient occlusion to strength 0.6 at a 4 cm radius, so layer order reads without adding outlines.
observable_checks: Panel edges and layer order remain readable; a claimed buildable pattern must be checked separately instead of inferred from this appearance.

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at renderer.toneMappingExposure 1.05; re-tune intensities and fog density under a different tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with technical-illustration labels or toy-miniature staging; playful impossible folds may be used when clearly presented as fiction.

defaults.rationale: In cut paper the drawing is the shadow between layers, so the key is placed low at 35 degrees and the ratio kept shallow at 2.4:1 - a high key would flatten the 1.5-3 mm layer offsets that carry the whole construction read. Roughness 0.85-1.0 with a faint sheen (#fffdf7 at 0.1) gives uncoated card its fibre response, and holding the paper white at #f4efe4 leaves headroom so the lit sheets never clip to featureless white.

values.value_structure: 25/50/25 dark/mid/light; the darks are cast shadows between layers, not printed ink
values.saturation_rule: printed colours <= 55% saturation so they read as flat ink; bare card stock under 12%

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 2.4:1 at a low key angle; the shadow between layers is the drawing

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: 0.9 uncoated card, 0.85 printed area; sheenColor #fffdf7 at sheen 0.1 for fibre response; no normal maps - every fold is geometry

values.signature_technique: a 35 degree low key over 1.5-3 mm layer offsets, so the cast shadow between sheets states the construction without any outline pass
never: paper texture mapped onto a solid mesh
